kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نحتجب (form VIII)
# نَحْتَجِبُ (naḥtajibu) /naħ.ta.d͡ʒi.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# نَحْتَجِبَ (naḥtajiba) /naħ.ta.d͡ʒi.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
# نَحْتَجِبْ (naḥtajib) /naħ.ta.d͡ʒib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِحْتَجَبَ (iḥtajaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
